vllm_0.6.3.post1_read.source: read from source, vLLM 0.6.3.post1 (vllm/lora/punica.py, layers.py, lora.py, ops/*.py); not run; newer versions untested
vllm_0.6.3.post1_read.form: unmerged; gathered by adapter index inside Triton kernels (Punica SGMV for prefill, BGMV for decode); no per-adapter cuBLAS GEMM, no merge
vllm_0.6.3.post1_read.base: base_layer.quant_method.apply(x) first (the model's normal GEMM over all tokens), then add_lora adds the update in place into that bf16 output
vllm_0.6.3.post1_read.scale: LoRALayerWeights.optimize folds scaling into lora_b in the LoRA dtype at load; kernels get scale 1.0
vllm_0.6.3.post1_read.shrink: x @ A into a zeroed fp32 buffer; sgmv_shrink: tiles 32x16x32 per segment of consecutive same-adapter tokens, SPLIT_K=8, tl.atomic_add; bgmv_shrink: SPLIT_K=64, BLOCK_K=256, products and sum in bf16 (tl.sum of a*b), tl.atomic_add
vllm_0.6.3.post1_read.expand: buffer cast to bf16 (CAST_TYPE), @ B; sgmv_expand: fp32 accumulate, cast to bf16, then + the bf16 output; bgmv_expand: bf16 products and sum + output
vllm_0.6.3.post1_read.prefill_vs_decode: PunicaWrapper picks sgmv in prefill (mapping.is_prefill) and bgmv in decode: two kernels, two rounding orders
vllm_0.6.3.post1_read.rank: lora_a/b_stacked sized max_lora_rank; smaller ranks zero-padded (set_lora copies into [:r])
vllm_0.6.3.post1_read.grouping: compute_meta merges consecutive tokens with the same adapter into one segment, so a segment's M depends on the neighbours; the grid is cdiv(max segment length, 32) x tiles x segments

setup.scales: alpha/r on even adapters, alpha/sqrt(r) on odd
